newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares end flat, downside seen.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares end flat, downside seen.

text.p: Slovenian shares ended mildly weaker on Monday on low volume, and traders said the absence of most participants, due to an annual bourse seminar was to blame for the muted activity.
"I expect shares to slide over the week on low volumes and I cannot forecast any improvement over the summer unless foreigners resume buying," said Dejan Bjelobaba, a trader of brokerage Fiba.
* The SBI index eased 0.5 point to 1,297.79.
* Overall six shares fell, six rose and one was flat, while 15 were untraded.
* Turnover fell to 27.1 million tolars from 69.7 million. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
